Master Piece#000.src: Talk to Caissop the artist, in his tent at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]
Master Piece#000.dst: Habla con Caissop, el artista, en su tienda en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]

Master Piece#002.src: Oh sorry, I didn't notice you. Did you want an autograph?
Master Piece#002.dst: Oh, perdona, no te había visto. ¿Querías un autógrafo?
Master Piece#002.speaker: Caissop

Master Piece#003.src: Wait, no? Don't you know who I am?! It seems like you have no taste in art... I am Caissop, the legendary artist!
Master Piece#003.dst: ¿Cómo que no? ¡¿No sabes quién soy?! Parece que no tienes gusto artístico... ¡Soy Caissop, el artista legendario!
Master Piece#003.speaker: Caissop

Master Piece#004.src: Though, since you are not a fan... Perhaps you can help me? I am looking for a new assistant.
Master Piece#004.dst: Aunque, ya que no eres admirador... ¿Quizá puedas ayudarme? Busco un nuevo ayudante.
Master Piece#004.speaker: Caissop

Master Piece#005.src: Excellent... I need your help to find three legendary creatures that are hiding in caves around the swamp.
Master Piece#005.dst: Excelente... Necesito que me ayudes a hallar tres criaturas legendarias escondidas en cuevas del pantano.
Master Piece#005.speaker: Caissop

Master Piece#006.src: I actually know their location, but unfortunately, I am...blind.
Master Piece#006.dst: Sé dónde están, pero, por desgracia, soy... ciego.
Master Piece#006.speaker: Caissop

Master Piece#007.src: For me to do my work I need to imagine them! That's where you come in. I need you to find them and describe them to me!
Master Piece#007.dst: ¡Para trabajar necesito imaginármelas! Ahí entras tú. ¡Necesito que las encuentres y me las describas!
Master Piece#007.speaker: Caissop

Master Piece#008.src: Would you turn your back on a blind man?! I need you to give me an accurate description of them! Once you have found one, come back and describe it to me exactly!
Master Piece#008.dst: ¡¿Le darías la espalda a un ciego?! ¡Necesito una descripción exacta de ellas! ¡Cuando encuentres una, vuelve y descríbemela con todo detalle!
Master Piece#008.speaker: Caissop

Master Piece#009.src: The first cave is up a hill with tall, thin-leafed flowers. They smell pink to me, and of this I am certain.
Master Piece#009.dst: La primera cueva está en un cerro con flores altas de hojas finas. Me huelen a rosa, de eso estoy seguro.
Master Piece#009.speaker: Caissop

Master Piece#010.src: Search for the first mythical creature in the cave at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]
Master Piece#010.dst: Busca la primera criatura mítica en la cueva de [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]

Master Piece#011.src: Report back with the description of the brown, large-snouted creature to Caissop
Master Piece#011.dst: Vuelve y descríbele a Caissop la criatura marrón de gran hocico

Master Piece#012.src: Quick! Describe it to me! Go on!
Master Piece#012.speaker: Caissop

Master Piece#013.src: Brown...big-nosed... A Villager Cow, you say!?
Master Piece#013.speaker: Caissop

Master Piece#015.src: ...MH, NO, A LITTLE MORE RED!..... YES!
Master Piece#015.speaker: Caissop

Master Piece#016.src: Haha! This is WONDERFUL! I'm not going to show it to you before it is finished!
Master Piece#016.dst: ¡Jaja! ¡Esto es MARAVILLOSO! ¡No te lo enseñaré hasta que esté acabado!
Master Piece#016.speaker: Caissop

Master Piece#017.src: Savor the ideas! So now, I need you to go to the second cave...
Master Piece#017.dst: ¡Saborea las ideas! Y ahora, ve a la segunda cueva...
Master Piece#017.speaker: Caissop

Master Piece#018.src: It is down a road, with short, round-cupped flowers. Those ones smell orange to me!
Master Piece#018.dst: Está junto a un camino, con flores bajas de cáliz redondo. ¡Esas me huelen a naranja!
Master Piece#018.speaker: Caissop

Master Piece#019.src: Hurry! I'll finish this animal while you are gone. OH, YES. MUY MACHO.
Master Piece#019.dst: ¡Corre! Acabaré este animal mientras no estás. OH, SÍ. MUY MACHO.
Master Piece#019.speaker: Caissop

Master Piece#020.src: Search for the second mythical beast in the cave at [-{~},-{~}]
Master Piece#020.dst: Busca la segunda bestia mítica en la cueva de [-{~},-{~}]

Master Piece#021.src: Report back with the description of the white, big-horned creature to Caissop
Master Piece#021.dst: Vuelve y descríbele a Caissop la criatura blanca de gran cuerno

Master Piece#022.src: You're here! Quick! Don't look at me, describe it!
Master Piece#022.speaker: Caissop

Master Piece#023.src: Snow white, a large horn... A Unicorn Sheep, you say?!
Master Piece#023.dst: Blanca como la nieve, un gran cuerno... ¿¡Una Oveja Unicornio!?
Master Piece#023.speaker: Caissop

Master Piece#024.src: ...OH YES, THE WOOL IS REAL... MORE SWIPING... OH YES, BIEN!
Master Piece#024.dst: ...OH SÍ, LA LANA ES REAL... MÁS TRAZOS... ¡OH SÍ, BIEN!
Master Piece#024.speaker: Caissop

Master Piece#025.src: ... THIS IS UNIQUE, REMARKABLE, YES. SUPERNATURAL!
Master Piece#025.speaker: Caissop

Master Piece#026.src: The last creature! Red-smelling flowers, prickly thorns, hurry, mucho inspired!
Master Piece#026.dst: ¡La última! Flores con olor a rojo, espinas, corre, ¡muy inspirado!
Master Piece#026.speaker: Caissop

Master Piece#027.src: ... OH, NO, NO. YES! MORE COLOUR, MORE PAINT! I'M OUT OF RED!
Master Piece#027.dst: ... OH, NO, NO. ¡SÍ! ¡MÁS COLOR, MÁS PINTURA! ¡SE ME ACABÓ EL ROJO!
Master Piece#027.speaker: Caissop

Master Piece#028.src: I'LL JUST USE MY BLOOD! OH! YES! ...INSPIRED! REMARKABLE! Huh? Why are you still here? Go! I need that last description!
Master Piece#028.dst: ¡USARÉ MI PROPIA SANGRE! ¡OH! ¡SÍ! ...¡INSPIRADO! ¡EXTRAORDINARIO! ¿Eh? ¿Sigues aquí? ¡Ve! ¡Necesito esa última descripción!
Master Piece#028.speaker: Caissop

Master Piece#029.src: Search for the third and last mythical animal in the cave at [-{~},-{~}]
Master Piece#029.dst: Busca el tercer y último animal mítico en la cueva de [-{~},-{~}]

Master Piece#030.src: Report back with the description of the pink, flying creature to Caissop
Master Piece#030.dst: Vuelve y descríbele a Caissop la criatura rosa voladora

Master Piece#031.src: You're finally back! I just finished the last one. Go! Describe it!
Master Piece#031.dst: ¡Por fin vuelves! Acabo de terminar el último. ¡Venga! ¡Descríbela!
Master Piece#031.speaker: Caissop

Master Piece#034.src: ...OH YES, WINGS! EYES FROM HEAVEN! OH, YES.
Master Piece#034.dst: ...¡OH SÍ, ALAS! ¡OJOS DEL CIELO! OH, SÍ.
Master Piece#034.speaker: Caissop

Master Piece#035.src: Och, Perfect. The final touch and, done! You were so inspiring that I made two! One for you, and one for me!
Master Piece#035.dst: Oh, perfecto. El último toque y, ¡listo! ¡Me inspiraste tanto que hice dos! ¡Uno para ti y otro para mí!
Master Piece#035.speaker: Caissop

Master Piece#036.src: You might want to hold onto that, big-town upper class Villagers pay through the roof for Caissop's work!
Master Piece#036.dst: Más te vale guardarlo: ¡los aldeanos ricos de las grandes ciudades pagan un dineral por la obra de Caissop!
Master Piece#036.speaker: Caissop

Master Piece#037.src: Thank you for your assistance, what a rush! Good luck on your Gavel adventure!
Master Piece#037.dst: ¡Gracias por tu ayuda, qué subidón! ¡Suerte en tu aventura por Gavel!
Master Piece#037.speaker: Caissop
